period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 30 September 2015' and 'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited) for the period ended 30 September 2015', tiled alongside the parallel Consolidated statements in a dense multi-column PDF layout that pdftotext -layout interleaves into a single jumbled block of text per line; the Solo column values used here were disentangled from the Consolidated column and cross-validated against both the balance-sheet identity and P&L subtotal arithmetic (both check out exactly, see below), giving confidence the correct column was read. Solo Total Property and Assets 216,748,562,634 vs Consolidated 224,375,059,908. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: sum of Solo asset lines (17,578,174,252+24,774,641,493+0+20,732,083,276+135,437,876,797+2,965,786,084+15,260,000,732) = 216,748,562,634 = Total Liabilities 198,499,452,569 + Total shareholders' equity 18,249,110,065. Income-statement items are Jan-to-Sept-2015 cumulative; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended July to Sept 2015' column (Solo interest income 4,668,072,786; PAT 832,702,086; EPS 1.17) not recorded here. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII = interest income - interest expense; total operating income = NII + investment income + commission + other income; profit before provisions = total operating income - opex; PBT = profit before provisions - total provision; PAT = PBT - tax); operating_profit_cumulative below is the source's 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' line (no separate operating-profit subtotal exists in this document format). 'borrowings' is a calculated sum of four reported liability lines (borrowings from other banks/FIs, borrowings from central bank, convertible subordinate bonds, money at call and short notice-liability), matching this bank's 2016_Q3/2017_Q1 solo-filing convention. This particular filing capture (182 lines) ends mid-note (selective note 2.5) and does not include the 'Key Financial Indicators/Ratios' performance-highlights section that the adjacent 2015_Q2 filing has, so no CAR/ROA/ROE/AD-ratio figures are available for this quarter. Dec-2014 comparative figures here (Solo Total Property and Assets 204,593,071,725; Total shareholders' equity 17,756,396,097) match the 2015_Q2 filing's Dec-2014 comparative exactly - no restatement detected.
